channel.title: Hosila Software — Product Updates
channel.description: New hospitality features and updates for Hosila PMS and Hosila IMS.

item.title: Hosila IMS v1.0.0
item.description: First full commercial release of Hosila IMS—dependable offline inventory control for central stores, kitchens, and bars with crate-to-bottle conversions, automatic stock valuation, and market Excel list import.

item.title: Hosila PMS v1.0.0
item.description: First full commercial release of Hosila PMS with fast room check-ins, multi-desk hotel Wi-Fi connection, corporate split bills, integrated hotel restaurant billing, and daily accounts.

item.title: Hosila IMS v0.9.2
item.description: Added dedicated Protein store section grouping, shared multi-department items, and formatted Weekly Stock Sheet Excel exports.

item.title: Hosila PMS v0.9.5
item.description: Added clear staff permission locks, reliable hotel logo display in guest emails, and shift handover cash reconciliation.
